title: David
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
Today you will learn that David 
trusted & obeyed 
the Lord with all his heart

David looked after sheep
He loved them and protected them from wild animals
David protected the sheep from 
LIONS and BEARS!!!

David loved the Lord and feared the Lord
And when he heard Goliath the Philistine giant
say bad things about the Lord
HE GOT CROSS that Goliath said bad things
So he decided to take on the big scary giant!

David took 5 stones to a sword fight
He didn’t fight the giant with a sword or spear
He fought with the Lord on his side and 5 stones and a sling

And the shepherd boy WON the battle
He told King Saul that the Lord rescued him from 
bears and lions 
and that the Lord would rescue him 
from the giant too!
We must have gigantic faith in Jesus like David
